text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe ran a great race in the 
Japan Cup. Though a faint doubt 
lingered—could her "friend" actually be an 
evil witch? But—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy said that Manhattan Cafe's 
running didn't look cursed at all; rather, 
it was dazzling to behold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lingering excitement after the race is 
fleeting. Following the forceful guidance 
of her "friend," she arrives at a place 
where she once again witnesses that 
dazzling light she saw before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's comeback after announcing 
an indefinite hiatus—a declaration to run 
in the Arima Kinen. Yesterday's friend 
stands before her as today's rival.
